intent: enterprise repo init: default mode to strict, widen choices to full set
notes: Change `gator-enterprise repo init --mode` default from `evidence_only` to `strict`. Per Architect direction 2026-08-07: "commits should not go silently. The commit should record everything it can, forcing the bot, human, etc. to explain what is happening with the commit." `strict` is the only mode that FORCES the explanation (blocks without commit_draft.md). `warning` still requires the same content but downgrades block→warning for CI/bot repos that can't respond to a block. `evidence_only` and `off` remain available as explicit opt-outs.

Widen `--mode` choices list from `["evidence_only", "warning"]` to `["off", "evidence_only", "warning", "strict"]` — all four values the bundled pre-commit script actually recognizes. Prior narrow list would let an operator pass e.g. `--mode strict` and get an argparse error even though the wrapper's mode lookup handles strict fine; the narrower list was inconsistent with runtime behavior.

Reverses the pre-2026-08-07 enterprise-cli design intent (the help text pointed operators to Gator Individual for strict/charter enforcement). The framing shift here: strict IS the enterprise default; opt-out to evidence_only or warning is an explicit choice per repo, not the initial posture.
Updates help text to describe all four modes and their tradeoffs, so `gator-enterprise repo init --help` documents the choice space.

No test breakage: `enterprise/tests/test_repo_init.py::TestRepoInitIntegration::test_do_repo_init_writes_intent_even_when_server_unknown` passes `mode="evidence_only"` EXPLICITLY (not by default), so it continues to verify the non-default branch. All 8 test_repo_init tests still pass.
Charter TRIPWIRE added in `.gator/charters/scripts-enterprise.md` documenting the new default, the framing rationale (Architect quote), the choices-list widening, and the regression pin.

Addresses Finding-set observation from Session 3: session-block generation without a bound vendor session is one thing; the commit ceremony being SILENT about it is another. This commit addresses the "silent" part by making the default posture explanatory. Multi-session capture (Issue B in the arc plan) is a separate follow-up.
